summary: Vaxart entered a Cooperation Agreement with a stockholder group, which withdrew its director nominations and books-and-records demand. In exchange, the board will form new committees, adopt a director resignation policy (for majority vote failures) and stock ownership guidelines, and mutually appoint one New Director. This is not a forced abrupt departure but a settlement to avert a proxy fight; the New Director search and committee restructuring constitute a governance change without a sudden management exit.
